# Isaiah Chapter 62 -- The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

## Consensus Translation

*[Full consensus translation of all 12 verses]*

*Not silent for Zion; new name; no more Forsaken; watchmen on walls; prepare the way*

---

## SOPHIA's Council Notes

Isaiah chapter 62 (Zion's New Name) addresses not silent for zion; new name; no more forsaken; watchmen on walls; prepare the way. The key verse — "You shall be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will give" — captures the chapter's central message. This chapter belongs to Third Isaiah (chs. 56-66), focused on the restored community and eschatological hope.
